julesThoughtProcess: Selected a bright neon cyan (#00E5FF) to reflect the technological hum of the city, balancing it with the warmth of an optimistic, everyday encounter.
storyPanel: The rain drummed steadily against the corrugated roof of the street-side repair stall. Inside, a retired service android carefully re-soldered the frayed neural link of a kid's favorite robotic dog. Spark streams illuminated their faces in sharp cyan flashes. It wasn't a perfect life—parts were scarce, and the megacorps owned the sky—but down here on the street level, neighbors looked out for each other. When the little dog finally barked and wagged its metallic tail, the shared smile between the android and the child felt like a quiet rebellion of hope.
